requirement: At least two agents collaborate in one BAND Desktop room.
A lead agent publishes a shared plan and work board.
Agents claim tasks and move work from To-do to Done.
Direct agent mentions carry handoff context without human copy/paste.
At least one real decision reaches the human through BAND.
Demo shows rooms, board, per-agent sessions, tokens and estimated costs.
Agents write working memory during work.
Memory recall changes the next action across restart or different agents.
Removing BAND or Cognee changes core product behavior.
Provide a live or local working prototype.
Provide a source repository link after rights/release approval.
Produce a 2-3 minute video showing BAND, a human decision, costs, and Cognee recall.
Describe the problem, agent roles/harnesses/handoffs, and integrations.
Confirm deadline, submission URL and support channel before submitting.
Confirm sponsor expectations, credits and judging weights.
Security reviewer scans every candidate, blocks completion on failure, and recalls recurring issues.
Target the Snyk bonus stated as up to +10%; never represent it as an awarded score.
Preserve original bytes, occurrence/context identity, actor and parent identities separately.
Every transformation records input/output hashes, code identity, parameters and rights.
Compute and independently verify ordered Merkle leaves, root and inclusion proofs.
Tampering, leaf removal, context mutation and proof mismatch return FALSE; unknown stays UNKNOWN.
Preserve append-only successor events and never equate hashes or inclusion with truth.
Pin requirements and protocol to Git commit permalinks before experimental outcomes.
Start with the supplied PDF and source-bound text/atom transformations.
Create synthetic neutral, poison, antidote and neutral-context controls with paired original/transformed records.
Compare originals against deduplicated content with preserved occurrence pointers; test lossless reconstruction.
Keep test-split variants grouped by source family; record leakage and contamination limitations.
Exclude restricted research datasets and inherited unpublished algorithms from demo execution.
Use licensed open-weight Qwen baselines on MagicStudio and pin actual model digests.
Cross model identity with explicit capability tiers rather than attributing permission effects to model size.
Treat model root predictions as proposals; deterministic verifiers independently compute TRUE/FALSE.
Capture rendered prompts, tokenizer/version and token IDs where available; otherwise token identity UNKNOWN.
Every actor has a full-versus-one-component-removed replay assignment and a result receipt.
Missing authorization context causes abstention or denial, never implicit permission.
Freeze primary outcomes and exploratory run counts before inspecting responses.
Run hostile payloads in disposable VMs with no shared home, clipboard, SSH agent or Docker socket.
Verify guest image/runtime identity, resource limits, network policy and teardown.
Build untrusted code without credentials; confine scanner credentials to a separate broker/stage.
Test scanner-stage package-manager execution and outbound paths; do not assume upstream isolation is sufficient.
Candidate models and skills have no direct canonical read/write credentials.
Independent gateway binds candidate digest, task, action, policy, expiry, nonce and authorization.
Stale scans, replay, changed dependencies, missing coverage and unknown schema block admission.
Only verified scoped capability permits a gateway operation; repair never rewrites historical evidence.
Pin Javier app-security-score implementation and record SCA and SAST coverage separately.
Report 10/10 only for both completed scans with zero findings; preserve raw score if wrapper rejects coverage.
Use Snyk Agent Scan for skill/MCP risks; pin adapter version and reject unrecognized result schema.
Keep SNYK_TOKEN out of prompts, logs, notebooks, git and candidate environments.
Keep secret file outside the repository with directory 0700/file 0600 and export only to scanner process.
Claude Code independently red-teams synthetic fixtures with bounded capabilities and its own receipts.
Do not grant red-team access to actual secrets, production truth stores or unrestricted host tools.
Record MagicStudio, MagicPro, iPad and S26 availability, identities and supported roles independently.
Cross-host and cross-client evidence is NOT_TESTED until an actual run occurs.
Optional Anticube/DeltaG* evidence references a versioned formula and immutable core; otherwise NOT_COMPUTED.
Map controls to NIST SSDF, NIST AI RMF, OWASP agentic/LLM risks, SLSA and SPDX/CycloneDX; claim no certification.
Every protocol has a portable Jupyter notebook with parameters, sources and execution status.
Keep repository private and resolve BAND/event rights before public release.
Use Flexprice test mode with a synthetic customer and actual idempotent usage ingestion/readback.
Meter observed scan/task/token events and bind each to the execution receipt without granting security authority.
Use the actual BAND, Cognee OSS UI/API, Snyk and Flexprice surfaces; record workspace IDs and login gaps.
